==Description==
'''False-60''', the False version of [[A-60]], will be one of the many entities you may find within the [[Unnamed Sector]] or rarely after Door 500 in any other section.

==Behavior==
* When '''False-60''' spawns, it will Rush forward to the main room while playing faint static, hitting the main room's door and staying idle infront of it for a few seconds before rushing back to the void wall, despawning. 

* However, '''False-60''' will have a chance to rebound back to the main room if you are past door 75. This may repeat multiple times.

* '''False-60''' will also have a chance attack while being totally silent if you are past door 400.

* Past door 500, if the player has more than 100 Max HP through the use of V-Boosters, '''False-60''' will have a chance to wait long enough to force damage from [[Claustrophobia]].

==Strategies & Tips==
* To avoid being fooled by '''False-60''' past door 400, try rushing forward to see if you are able to open doors or watch out for the screen shake like you would do against [[SHA-2]]. If the door can't be opened but [[Mori]], [[False Witness]], [[Tackle]] or any their variants arent active, '''False-60''' is on his way.
* If '''False-60''' stays less than three seconds Infront the door before fallbacking that means that it'll rebound, so exit and re-enter the locker as fast as possible.

==Trivia==
* '''False-60''' has a rare chance of appearing outside the [[Unnamed Sector]].  Just like [[Mori]], [[False Witness]], and [[Tackle]].
* '''False-60''' is the only Unnamed Sector Invader not present in [[Super Epic Mode]].
* '''False-60'''s shares a design with [https://r-liminal-rooms.fandom.com/wiki/A-60 A-60] from '''Liminal Rooms'''.
* For some time, '''False-60''' still used his Pre-release design for its Jumpscare.
